Gabriel "FalleN" Toledo (born May 30, 1991) is a Brazilian professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, Counter-Strike: Source, Counter-Strike and CrossFire player. Playing as an in-game leader and awper throughout most of his career, after over 2 decades of professional play, FalleN announced in April 2026 he would retire at the end of the year. At the height of his career, FalleN was regarded as one of the world's foremost AWPers, ranking second on HLTV's list of the best players of 2016. [1]

FalleN is best known for his time on Luminosity Gaming and later SK Gaming in CS:GO, where he would win 2 major championships.
